meaning.en: (elec.) Designating or of:  A lightbulb with two filaments that can be switched on singly or together to produce three different levels of brightness. A switch with three terminals, used to control a circuit from two different locations.

sentences.en: This pipe was provided, close to the orifice, with a three-way cock, by means of which the steam might be first discharged into the sand, and the current between the cock and the well then suddenly reversed and diverted into the well.

sentences.en: Skeat has connected it with Old English lcietan, to let, which is very doubtful, though this is the origin of the use of the word in such expressions as "two-" "three-way leet," a place where cross-roads melt.
